## Football effect

Pendleton finished the game: the record logs the injury at the end of Atlanta's third-quarter touchdown drive with no removal, and he played the thirteen-play drive that followed and the fourth-quarter possessions with the reserves (the tackle on Boldewijn, the assist on Boldewijn's 1-yard catch). His work before it was the first-possession stop of Antone Smith for minus 3 and the assist on Hagens. The instruction after the game is out, and on the projection he misses the August 29 review and is reassessed that day; the September 1 projected return is the first day of the Week 1 preparation. No place is set for him and none is decided by the instruction; his roster disposition, if any, is Caldwell's with the user at the August 30 reduction. No football finding attaches to the instruction.
